Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return one row per compound with columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
